description:
These kite mosaic tiles for kitchen walls are glazed ceramic pieces cut in a kite, or elongated diamond, shape and finished in a warm yellow glaze.

## How they look
Kite shapes fit together into a pattern of diamonds and stars, so even a single colour gives the wall movement. The yellow glaze reflects light, which helps brighten kitchens with small windows.

## Where they work
- **Backsplashes behind the counter and stove**, where the glaze is generally simple to keep clean.
- **A feature wall in an open kitchen or dining corner**, with plain tiles or paint on the other walls.
- **Pairing with the green version**: Pak Clay also lists a [light green kite mosaic](/products/light-green-glazed-kite-ceramic-mosaic-kitchen-wall-tiles), so you can mix the two for a two-tone pattern.

## Good to know
Geometric mosaics look best when the first row is set perfectly level, so mark a guide line before fixing. A white grout keeps the shape clear; a warm beige grout makes the wall softer.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the yellow against your cabinets, then get a dated quote for your wall. More designs are in the [kitchen wall mosaic range](/categories/mosaic-kitchen-wall-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of kite mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can I mix the yellow and green kite tiles?
faqs.a: Yes. Pak Clay lists the kite mosaic in yellow and in light green, and the same shape can be mixed for a two-tone pattern. Ask for both samples and lay them out before deciding.

faqs.q: Kite mosaic or subway tiles for a kitchen?
faqs.a: Kite mosaic is more decorative and makes the wall a focal point; subway tiles are quieter and suit a minimal kitchen. Choose kite for one feature wall and keep the rest simple.

faqs.a: Message +92 300 4617715 on WhatsApp with the product name and city, or visit the Lahore or Islamabad showroom.
